la:other:Ufens.html:
Ūfens (Oufens, ap. Müll.), entis, m.
A small river in Latium, that flows past Tarracina, now Ufente, ; ; .— Hence, ūfentīnus (Oufent-), a, um, adj., of or belonging to the Ufens, Ufentine: tribus,one of the thirty-five Roman tribes,; cf. .—
A man's name, ; ; ; .
